title: Plaguelands: The Scarlet Enclave
body: In the far southeastern corner of the Plaguelands, beyond the blight, the Scarlet Crusade built a haven, the Scarlet Enclave: the farms and mine of Havenshire, the walled town of New Avalon and a fleet at anchor off the coast. Then a necropolis appeared in the sky. Acherus, the Ebon Hold, has come to rest above it, and from it the Lich King looses his newest weapon, the death knights, against the Crusade, with Light's Hope Chapel to follow.

parts.body: In the end the Enclave burned: Havenshire ruined, the fleet sunk, New Avalon broken, and the last Scarlet armies slain beneath the necropolis.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Plaguelands:_The_Scarlet_Enclave (southeastern corner of the Plaguelands, towns pristine and untouched by death, Scarlet holdings)

title: Acherus: The Ebon Hold
body: Acherus is the necropolis built as the citadel of the Lich King's death knights, and its masters boast that not even Naxxramas could withstand it. In its upper hall Instructor Razuvious judges each newly raised knight, sending the worthy to the Lich King and disposing of those who wake with too much of their old selves. Below, in the Hall of Command, Highlord Mograine and the masters of blood, frost and unholy teach.

parts.body: After Light's Hope the knights who broke free came back through death gates and cut down the horrors their old master had left behind, and the Ebon Hold became the seat of the Ebon Blade.

title: Death's Breach
body: Death's Breach, the plateau beneath the Ebon Hold, is the staging ground for the assault on the Enclave. Here Prince Valanar, one of the blood princes of the Scourge, drives the attack and teaches new knights their first lesson, terror, while Gothik the Harvester, grand necromancer of Naxxramas, Salanar the Horseman and Orithos the Sky Darkener each claim their share of new blood.

parts.body: When Havenshire fell the Lich King himself came down to the Breach, and from above it he watched the last Scarlet armies die, taunting them that their Light had abandoned them.

title: Havenshire
body: Havenshire is the working heart of the Enclave, farms, stables, a lumber mill and a mine north of New Avalon's walls, whose people feed and supply the Crusade. It is the first place the death knights strike. As they come, the Crusade strips the mine and loads its ore aboard the frigates at Light's Point, guarded by a blockade on the beach, while the villagers run for the safety of New Avalon.

parts.body: A death knight smuggled behind the blockade in a mine car turned a ship's own cannons on the beach, and in minutes the entire Scarlet fleet was gone.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Havenshire (north of New Avalon, constant siege, mill and stables abandoned, citizens fled to New Avalon)

title: New Avalon
body: New Avalon is the Crusade's last bastion in the Enclave, a walled town of orchards, forge, town hall, chapel and the great Scarlet Hold. Its people were promised safety, but as Havenshire's survivors crowd in, High General Abbendis tells them only the pure of heart may stay, and an angry crowd at the town hall demands to know where the last ships are going, and what the Crimson Dawn might be.

parts.body: The town registry, taken from the murdered mayor, showed three ships already sailing for Northrend, and beside their course the words Crimson Dawn.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/New_Avalon (subzones)

parts.body: The chapel's prison house held Argent Dawn captives, and among them, for each knight, a champion of their own people who begged them to remember who they had been. They were given a quick end.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/New_Avalon (subzones)

parts.body: The walls did not hold. The Scourge ran freely through the streets, and when the last Scarlet armies came to save the town, it was already burning.

title: King's Harbor
body: King's Harbor, on the bluffs below the Scarlet Overlook, holds the Crusade's docks. Here High General Brigitte Abbendis, once a paladin of the Silver Hand, waits with a chosen company for a courier from Hearthglen, while the people of New Avalon beg for a place on the last ship, and ballistas line the road down from the overlook.

parts.body: A death knight in the dead courier's clothes brought false word, and Abbendis gave the Scarlet lands up for lost: the armies were to turn for Northrend, no longer the Scarlet Crusade but the Scarlet Onslaught.

title: Koltira Deathweaver and Thassarian
body: Thassarian was a soldier of Lordaeron who followed Arthas to Northrend and was raised there as a death knight. In Quel'Thalas he slew the high elf Koltira Deathweaver, who rose as a death knight in turn, and in undeath the two became brothers. Behind the lines in New Avalon, Koltira was captured and dragged in irons to the Scarlet Hold, and Thassarian would not leave him to the Crusade.

parts.body: Koltira was found, ribs broken, and cursed the rescue as a breach of their covenants, yet he shielded his rescuer while High Inquisitor Valroth fell, then stayed behind to draw the Crusade's fire.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Koltira_Deathweaver (high elf, slain by Thassarian, brothers in death)

parts.body: In Northrend Thassarian fights for the Alliance: at Valiance Keep he was given a dozen men to storm the Wailing Ziggurat, and took it, though the men who fought beside him call him a good man and his own sister came north searching for him.
